description: This file defines a function `makeOpenAIChatCompletionRequest` that manages streaming chat completion requests to OpenAI's API with support for real-time updates, handling various types of responses such as text, images, reasoning content, and search results. It includes handling of multiple callback functions for UI updates, timing, usage tracking, and more.

methods.name: makeOpenAIChatCompletionRequest
methods.description: An asynchronous function that sends a chat completion request to OpenAI's API with streaming enabled. It manages the response stream, extracts content, reasoning, images, search results, and usage data, and invokes appropriate callbacks for UI updates and analytics.
